title: One thing at a time — идиомы

items.idiom: do less work in a day
items.example: Multi-taskers do less work in a day than others.
When you multi-task, you forget names and numbers.
I can't remember normal things easily.
Multi-taskers eat very fast and too much.
You don't think about food, so you eat too much.
Finally, your stress levels go up.
Turn off your phone and just talk and listen.
